title: Dongying VTS (Dongying port)
authority: Dongying MSA (中华人民共和国东营海事局), Dongying VTS Centre (东营海事局船舶交通管理中心)
applies_to: Foreign ships; Chinese ships of 500 GT and over; passenger ships; ships carrying dangerous goods; ships restricted in their ability to manoeuvre; others who join by choice. Not military, government, fishing or sports craft. A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
applies_quote: 第四条 除军用船、公务船、渔船和体育运动船舶外，下列船舶在VTS区域内航行、停泊和作业时，应通过VTS工作频道或其他有效手段向VTS中心报告：（一）外国籍船舶；（二）500总吨及以上中国籍船舶；（三）客船；（四）载运危险货物的船舶；（五）操纵能力受到限制的船舶；（六）其他自愿参加VTS动态报告的船舶。

when.text: Inbound reports: 1) on reaching the Dongying VTS area limit; 2) on reaching the line between light buoys D1 and D2 of the 100,000 t channel; 3) after all fast. Content: ship's name, call sign and cargo; position; draught (first report); movement; other items. (进港报告 1.抵达东营VTS服务区域边界时 2.抵达东营港十万吨级航道D1、D2灯浮连线时 3.靠妥码头后 … 1.船名、呼号及载货 2.报告时的位置 3.船舶吃水（首次报告时）4.航行动态 5.VTS中心要求的其他信息。)

Outbound reports: 1) before leaving the berth; 2) on leaving the line between light buoys D11 and D12 of the 100,000 t channel; 3) on leaving the Dongying VTS area limit. Content: name and call sign; position; destination; other. (出港报告 1.驶离码头前 2.驶离东营港十万吨级航道D11、D12灯浮连线时 3.驶离东营VTS服务区域边界时 …)
Anchor reports: when about to anchor or heave up, and after heaving up and after anchoring: name and call sign, position, other. (锚泊报告 1. 拟进行锚泊或起锚时 2. 起锚后及锚泊后)

Work report before starting and within one hour after finishing: opening up main engine, steering gear, windlass, boiler or other gear that affects manoeuvring; engine or sea trials; going alongside at anchor; towing connect or let go; other work affecting safety. (作业报告 … 在作业前和结束后一小时内向VTS中心报告。)

Special report at once: accident; aids to navigation not normal; obstruction; pollution; ship not under control; other emergency (name and call sign, the event, other). A false distress alert must be reported to the VTS at once (art. 21).
Pilots report boarding and leaving: ship's name, time, place, pilot's name or number, the ship's movement (art. 9).

how.note: VTS working channel; keep watch on CH 71 in the area (art. 19). Call name not printed.

how.to: Dongying VTS Centre (东营海事局船舶交通管理中心)
Maritime distress (海上遇险报警专用电话)
Dongying Pilot Station (东营港引航站)

lines.text: Ship's name and call sign (船名、呼号); inbound also the cargo (载货)
Position at the time of the report (报告时的位置)
Draught (船舶吃水), first inbound report
Movement (航行动态) inbound; destination (目的港) outbound
Other information the VTS asks (VTS中心要求的其他信息)

format_note: Voice reports on VHF CH 71. Mandarin or English. VTS works 0000 to 2400 Beijing time.

sources.title: 山东海事局关于公布《东营船舶交通管理系统安全监督管理细则》的通告 (Dongying VTS rules and Dongying VTS user guide)
sources.ref: Attachment .doc: rules arts. 4 to 9, 19, 26; user guide (reports table, pilot areas, contacts)

sources.title: Same text, copy on mcrrc.top (Shandong Jiaotong University law library)

verification: Rules, user guide, points, channel and contacts read from the official .doc attached to the Shandong MSA notice of 1 April 2022 (sd.msa.gov.cn), same as the mcrrc.top copy. The rules print longitude first; the user guide prints latitude first with the same figures. Copied in seconds as printed.
notes: Valid to 30 April 2027 (art. 27), so a new version may come out in 2027. The reporting line and the VTS area are the same four points; the text says 'sea area inside the line joining 4 points', so it is stored as a closed polygon (the side D-A runs close to the port; not confirmed whether it is meant to follow the coast). Radar blind areas: Dongying port north and south basins and between the breakwaters, 500 m off other berths, 500 m either side of bridges and causeways. No anchoring in channels or basins; no trials, speed tests or compass work in channels or anchorages; no overtaking in basins and channels and no crossing of channels or anchorages without VTS permission; ships must not meet in the breakwater entrance. Pilot boarding points: Dongying No. 2, circle 500 m round 38°10′.00N 119°07′.50E, wind force 7 or less; No. 3, circle 500 m round 38°10′.83N 119°06′.50E, ordinary ships, tankers and dangerous goods ships, wind force 7 or less, draught under 12.8 m. Not checked: the Dongying anchorage notice 鲁航通〔2025〕1251号 (anchorages #1 to #10).
